notes: APC mini page (/apc): a virtual APC mini plus the bridge for the real one, with pad modes for content, looks, overlays, shapes, layer FX, blends, 40 multi-layer stacks and hold-to bumps, a live output preview and the app logo. The standby logo card is now what a cold start shows. Strobe follows the beat clock, capped at 4 flashes a second. 40 new looks, 23 layer FX and 7 master FX presets. The example clip library is included.
